description: A brand's customer personas: who it markets to, their age range and awareness stage, with the angles and offers aimed at each. Each persona is a segment nickname, the buyer's situation in their words, its share of the brand's ads, how many ads and landing pages speak to it, and its top angles and offers. Empty until the brand has enough ads and pages read. Use it to answer 'who is this brand selling to' or to compare two brands' audiences. Fields this workspace can't see come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic). When a list is capped, `planLimit` is set: `maxResults` is the cap, `hiddenResults` is how many matching rows were not returned, and there is no next page. Do not estimate omitted values. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. For multi-step competitor research, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where a saved asset or new file lands. Its workspace's access applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's access applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_personas
title: Find a brand's personas
